summaries.en: FreeDomain is an open-source platform that provides free domain registration services, addressing the barrier of domain costs for developers and small projects. Built primarily with HTML, it offers a straightforward web interface for users to claim and manage domains without financial commitment. You can deploy it locally to create custom domain services or integrate its domain management logic into your own applications for testing and development purposes.
summaries.zh: FreeDomain 是一个开源域名注册平台，旨在为开发者和初创项目提供免费的域名服务，降低技术项目的入门门槛。该项目采用 HTML 构建简洁的网页界面，用户可直接在线申请和管理域名，无需支付费用。开发者可将其部署到本地环境，搭建个性化的域名分发系统，或借鉴其域名分配逻辑集成到自己的应用中，非常适合用于项目演示、测试环境搭建或教育用途的实践探索。

summaries.en: MoneyPrinterTurbo is an open-source Python tool that automates short video creation using AI large language models, addressing the time-intensive process of manual video production. It works by integrating multiple AI components—LLMs for script generation, text-to-speech for voiceovers, and moviepy for visual assembly—into a streamlined pipeline that requires minimal user input. Developers can use it to quickly prototype marketing content, educational explainers, or social media clips by simply providing a topic, then customize the workflow by swapping AI models or adjusting visual templates for specific needs.
summaries.zh: MoneyPrinterTurbo是一款基于Python的开源AI短视频自动生成工具。它通过集成大语言模型生成脚本、文本转语音合成旁白，并利用moviepy库处理视觉素材，构建了从主题输入到视频一键输出的高效流程。该工具采用模块化设计，支持灵活替换AI模型与调整视觉模板，便于用户快速制作营销、教育或社交类短片，同时可通过参数配置探索个性化风格，为内容创作提供了便捷的实验平台。

summaries.en: English-level-up-tips is a comprehensive guide for Chinese speakers aiming to master English efficiently. It distills proven language acquisition principles into a structured roadmap, emphasizing input-based learning (listening and reading) over rote memorization. The guide covers phonetics, vocabulary, grammar, and cultural immersion, with practical tips like using spaced repetition and native materials. You can follow the step-by-step plan to build a personalized study routine, or adapt its strategies for teaching others.
summaries.zh: 英语水平提升指南专为中文母语者设计，基于语言习得理论，强调通过大量可理解输入（听力和阅读）自然提升语感，避免死记硬背。教程系统梳理语音、词汇、语法及文化沉浸模块，融入间隔重复、影子跟读等科学方法。用户可按分阶段计划制定学习路线，或借鉴理念设计教学方案。核心价值在于提供从基础到流利的清晰路径，减少学习弯路。

summaries.en: iii is an open-source framework for building and managing real-time, composable services. It unifies APIs, agents, and backend logic into a single, observable system. Technically, it leverages Rust for performance and provides primitives for JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python. You can use it to quickly prototype distributed applications, integrate AI agents, or monitor service interactions in real-time. Ideal for developers building complex, event-driven architectures.
summaries.zh: iii 是一个开源框架，旨在帮助开发者轻松构建、组合和实时监控所有服务。它统一了 API、AI 代理和后端逻辑，形成一个可观察的系统。技术上，iii 使用 Rust 实现高性能核心，并提供 JavaScript、TypeScript 和 Python 的原语，方便不同技术栈的开发者使用。你可以用它快速搭建分布式应用原型、集成 AI 代理，或实时追踪服务间的交互。特别适合构建复杂的事件驱动架构，让开发者第一次能够实时地组合、扩展和观察每一个服务。

summaries.en: Stop-slop is a skill file designed to remove common AI tells from prose, making generated text sound more natural and human-like. It works by applying targeted edits to eliminate overused phrases, repetitive structures, and unnatural transitions typical of AI writing. Technically, it provides a systematic approach to post-process AI output, focusing on stylistic refinement rather than content generation. You can use it as a standalone tool or integrate it into your AI writing pipeline to polish drafts, improve readability, and reduce the 'AI voice' in newsletters, reports, or creative writing.
summaries.zh: Stop-slop 是一款专用于去除AI生成文本中常见痕迹的技能文件，旨在使机器写作更自然、更接近人类。其核心并非重新生成内容，而是通过一系列有针对性的编辑规则，消除典型AI腔调，如过度使用的短语、重复句式和不自然过渡词。技术上，它提供系统化的后处理方法，专注于风格优化而非内容创造。可作为独立工具使用，也可集成到AI写作流程中，用于润色草稿、提升可读性，使新闻稿、报告或创意写作摆脱千篇一律的机器感。

summaries.en: Claude Code Harness is an autonomous development framework that wraps Claude Code into a structured Plan→Work→Review cycle, solving the problem of inconsistent output quality in AI-assisted coding. Its key insight is enforcing a disciplined workflow where the AI plans before coding and reviews after, mimicking human best practices. You can use it to automate complex coding tasks, ensuring higher reliability and maintainability by simply integrating it into your existing Claude Code setup.
summaries.zh: Claude Code Harness 是一个自主开发框架，它将 Claude Code 封装成结构化的“计划→工作→审查”循环，解决了 AI 辅助编码中输出质量不稳定的问题。其核心设计理念是强制 AI 在编码前先制定计划、编码后进行审查，模仿人类最佳实践，从而提升代码的可靠性和可维护性。你可以通过将其集成到现有的 Claude Code 环境中，来自动化复杂的编码任务，并确保每次输出都经过严格的质量控制。

summaries.en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.
summaries.zh: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
